content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

This infrastructure solution is about decoupling digital commerce from the restrictive payment ecosystems that have come to dominate the industry. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script to host and automate digital download delivery, creators can avoid the 10% commission fees imposed by Gumroad and other traditional digital storefronts. With NOWPayments, the 0.5% fee cryptocurrency payment gateway, creators can now sell their digital products with minimal overhead, giving them greater control over their online stores and the value they create.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of this digital commerce stack is built around the principles of infrastructure sovereignty. By using Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script to host and automate digital download delivery, creators can enjoy the benefits of a self-sufficient online store that operates independently of traditional payment platforms. Meanwhile, NOWPayments provides a secure and efficient cryptocurrency payment processing system that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script, ensuring that digital product sales are verified and settled in real-time.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
This solution empowers creators to take full control of their online stores and the value they create.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this digital commerce solution today, creators can start by building and customizing their online store using the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Next, they can integrate NOWPayments with Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script to enable cryptocurrency payment processing. Finally, they can automate digital download delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that their digital products are delivered to customers in real-time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
NowPayments offers a 0.5% fee and seamless integration with Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script, making it an attractive option for creators looking to avoid traditional payment platforms.

If you're looking for a way to sell digital products like ebooks and templates without relying on traditional payment platforms, you're not alone. Many creators have turned to NOWPayments, a 0.5% fee cryptocurrency payment gateway that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script. By leveraging this solution, creators can avoid the 10% commission fees imposed by Gumroad and other traditional digital storefronts. To learn more about this solution, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. You can also shop for the Complete Builder Kit at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this digital commerce solution today, follow these concrete steps: (1) Build and customize your online store using the Complete Builder Kit ($197), (2) Integrate NOWPayments with Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script to enable cryptocurrency payment processing, (3) Automate digital download delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and (4) Configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle digital product delivery and customer notifications. By following these steps, you can deploy a self-sufficient online store that operates independently of traditional payment platforms.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does NOWPayments integrate with Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script?

NOWPayments integrates with Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script by leveraging the Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script API to automate digital download delivery and cryptocurrency payment processing. This integration enables creators to sell digital products to customers worldwide, regardless of the payment restrictions imposed by their countries or regions.
Can I use other cryptocurrency payment gateways with this solution?

Yes, you can use other cryptocurrency payment gateways with this solution, but you should be aware that the fees and compatibility may vary. NOWPayments offers a 0.5% fee and seamless integration with Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script, making it an attractive option for creators looking to avoid traditional payment platforms.
How do I configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle digital product delivery and customer notifications?

To configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle digital product delivery and customer notifications, you'll need to create a custom script that integrates with Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script. This script will automate digital product delivery and customer notifications, ensuring that your digital products are delivered to customers in real-time.
What happens if I encounter issues with NOWPayments or Cloudflare Pages?

If you encounter issues with NOWPayments or Cloudflare Pages, you can contact the support team directly for assistance. Additionally, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes comprehensive documentation and support resources to help you troubleshoot and resolve any issues that may arise.
Can I scale this solution to handle large volumes of digital product sales?

Yes, this solution can be scaled to handle large volumes of digital product sales. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script, you can automate digital download delivery and cryptocurrency payment processing, ensuring that your digital products are delivered to customers in real-time, regardless of the volume.
